mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which is a precursor to economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales by more than 2% over three months signals reduced consumer spending, leading to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS declines by more than 2% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% over three months signals a strong supply-side expansion, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 2% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable economic environment conducive to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) over a month signals a strengthening labor market, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when both PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls over a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a month signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines and UNRATE rises in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when HOUST declines and UNRATE rises over a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% over two quarters signals strong economic growth, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 increases by more than 2% over two quarters.
